title: Paul Gordan and Clebsch-Gordan: Source-Witnessed LaTeX and Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Paul Gordan / Clebsch-Gordan record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record contains source-witnessed German/Latin transcription and English translation working packets split out from the older mixed additional-author shelf.

Status at a glance. These are package-audited working drafts, not final critical editions. OCR is used only as a non-authoritative prose/block comparator; source renders and included scan witnesses remain the authority for formulas and mathematical readings.

Latest update. Adds Gordan_Abel22_p292_299_DE_EN_20260612.zip, covering Clebsch-Gordan Theorie der Abelschen Functionen source pp.292-299 / printed pp.270-277. It covers the beginning of Elfter Abschnitt, all of §77, all of §78, and the opening of §79 through the displayed transformation of w_i, with cumulative Abelsche German/English TeX/PDF through source p299, current and cumulative source-scan witnesses, formula crops/ledgers, render checks, and clean build logs. The audit reports no unresolved scan-quality blocker, preserves a source-visible p298 notation anomaly, and keeps OCR scaffold excerpts non-authoritative. The next continuation point is source p300 / printed p278, continuation of §79.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Adds Abel22 p292-p299, extending the cumulative Abelsche stream through source p299 / printed p277. Abel22 covers the beginning of Elfter Abschnitt, all of section 77, all of section 78, and the opening of section 79 through the displayed w_i transformation; next continuation is source p300 / printed p278. Package-audited working drafts only; OCR scaffold remains noncanonical.
